name: Lazer UI
description: A smooth, music-reactive menu overhaul inspired by osu!lazer.

enabled.name: Enable Lazer menu
enabled.description: Replace the main menu with the Lazer-style menu. Takes effect next time the menu loads.

background-dim.name: Background dim
background-dim.description: How much to darken the menu background, in percent.

background-blur.name: Blur background
background-blur.description: Blur the menu background, like osu!.

background-triangles.name: Background triangles
background-triangles.description: Show slowly drifting triangles over the background.
